context: Two teens compare their cram-school grind
purpose: Talk about studying; teach 塾/深夜/実力/選ば/起こっ/持た

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 今日も塾、遅くまである？
lines.en: Cram school again, going late today?
lines.style: curious teen checking her friend’s schedule

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん、塾は深夜近くまでだよ。
lines.en: Yeah, cram school runs until almost midnight.
lines.style: worn-out teen describing the grind, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 深夜まで勉強して実力つくのかな。
lines.en: Does studying till late night actually build skill?
lines.style: skeptical teen questioning the method, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 実力がないと志望校に選ばれないし。
lines.en: Without real ability you will not be picked by your school.
lines.style: pressured teen explaining the stakes, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: この前、塾で停電が起こったらしいよ。
lines.en: The other day a blackout happened at the cram school.
lines.style: gossipy teen sharing a rumor, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.style: startled teen leaning in for details

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 大したことは起きなかったみたい。
lines.style: reassuring teen downplaying it, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: ノート持たずに来ちゃって、借りたよ。
lines.en: I came without my notebook and had to borrow one.
lines.style: sheepish teen admitting his slip, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 私も予備を持たせてもらおうかな。
lines.en: Maybe I will have them lend me a spare too.
lines.style: practical teen planning ahead, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced
